prova:
constructor
  · rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro hc_not
    have h_zero : (0 : ℤ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, (0 : ℕ) * (n.choose i : ℤ) := by
      simp
    apply hc_not
    use fun _ => 0
    exact h_zero.symm
  · intro m hm
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hm
    by_contra! h_gt
    exact hm ⟨fun i => if i = 1 then (m + n).toNat else 0, by
      simp only [Finset.sum_congr]
      omega⟩
